title: Architecture walkthrough
purpose: Confirm components, data flows and trust boundaries, and answer the open questions from the document review.
outcomes: Two shared local administrator accounts without multi-factor authentication identified
SFTP key storage and extract handling described
Webhook signing status unknown; to be checked with the vendor
Payment file is moved by hand through a laptop
Northwind does not review vendor support access

statements.speaker: Marcus Lee
statements.text: Two local administrator accounts are shared by the payroll team and have no multi-factor authentication.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman
statements.text: The extract is deleted after a successful transfer.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman
statements.text: The SFTP key is in the service account's home folder and has not been rotated.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman
statements.text: Whether webhook signing is enabled is not known.

statements.speaker: Marcus Lee
statements.text: The payment file is downloaded to a laptop and uploaded to the bank portal; a second approver releases it.

statements.speaker: Marcus Lee
statements.text: Northwind has never requested the vendor's support access log.
